notation: WCA/SiGN; wide moves lowercase; slices M E S; rotations x y z
description: Winter Variation (WV): last-slot + corner-orientation. With the LL edges oriented (cross on top) and the last F2L pair connected and ready to be inserted with R U' R', insert it while orienting all four LL corners, forcing a PLL. 27 cases (one per corner-orientation state, incl. the case where R U' R' already orients them).
notes: algs[0] is the primary (from jperm.net); case state = inverse(algs[0]) applied to a solved cube. In that state the FR pair sits in the U layer such that R U' R' would insert it.
pre_auf[i] = clockwise U turns to apply to that case state BEFORE algs[i] (SpeedCubeDB alts usually include their own leading U/U2, so they often need a compensating pre-AUF).
No alg contains a cube rotation (algs with x/y/z were dropped). Trigger parentheses removed; moves otherwise verbatim.
id = SpeedCubeDB case number (WV 1-27); name = jperm.net case name (#n disambiguates jperm names used twice).
Recognition text is auto-derived from the simulated case state.
Verified with an independent sticker simulator: every alg solves the FR pair, keeps the rest of F2L, and orients all LL pieces for its case (LL permutation left for PLL).
